_comment: Copied to ~/.claude/progress-tracker/repos.json on first run. Toggle a repo with /progress-repos enable|disable <owner/repo>. moduleSource is 'labels' (a label names the module) or 'epics' (issues labelled epic are the modules; children are linked by #refs in either body). A repo whose 'modules' probes file has no code paths reports issue and PR progress only. 'localPath' names a checkout to use when the report runs on that machine (ignored elsewhere).

repos.title: TidyHaus
repos._note: Modules come from the code (config/modules/tidyhaus.json): the label pattern matches nothing, so PRs are placed by the files they change and issues by their PR or their words. Epics are not requirements. PRs that name no tracked issue go to the module their files belong to, only those fitting no module to M00, with no warning for either (David, 28 Oct 2026).

repos.title: Wyset
repos._note: Work lands on main with 'Ref #NN' in the commit message and stories stay open, so a default-branch commit citing a story counts it done.
